fusions.name: Drifting Mouthful
fusions.desc: Sends a slow drift of locusts into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Becalming Drift
fusions.desc: The swarm settles over every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, rising 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40% more.

fusions.name: Nothing Is Urgent
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
